criteria.requirement: Extend delivered canonical_cache with cache_invalidate(*args,**kwargs) using the SAME make_key/signature/default/custom-key path as reads. Return True only when existing entry deleted; missing returns False, invalid call/key errors propagate. Preserve all unrelated entries and hit/miss statistics, per-method-self identity and custom business IDs. Run invalidation under same computation RLock so a completed call cannot later silently refill invalidated value; explicitly no cancellation of already-running user code. Do not call cache_clear internally or reset all stats. Keep existing default/cache_clear behavior.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
